candidate_pool.definition: cards observed in training decks, excluding visible/command-zone cards, approximate color-identity subset

collapse_conclusion: strong recommendation concentration is visible in the Top-25 catalog coverage diagnostic.

comparisons.commander_conclusion: Commander-specific signal is not estimable here: every test command zone is unseen, so B2/B3 correctly fall back to B1.
comparisons.context_conclusion: Clean context-only B4 is weak, but commander-plus-context B4 and B5 both show robust held-out uplift.

decision.label: YELLOW
decision.rationale: Commander-plus-context and hybrid signals are robust, but pure context-only B4 fails and target coverage is only 55.0%.

deepsets_conclusion: not justified by this throwaway pilot; no neural model was built.

masking.card_identity: scryfallOracleId; unique card IDs per deck; source multiplicity not used as repeated positives

matrix_factorization_conclusion: a follow-up is plausible after broader deck coverage, but this pilot does not justify adding B6 now.
production_recommendation: make no production change; use this only to prioritize a broader, frozen M4-style completion benchmark.
segment_conclusion: all test examples are unseen cold commanders; high-data and low-data commander segments are not estimable.
